title: Kimi Code Desktop Client Launch: macOS and Windows Synchronized Release

content_html:
Kimi Code desktop client for macOS and Windows is now available. Users can start installing and using it by visiting kimi.com/code.

Designed for developers' actual workflows, the desktop version offers built-in terminal, browser, and Git status viewing features. It supports running and debugging projects directly, reviewing code changes, and linking to PR status, making it easier to track code review and merge progress.
